purpose: Discovery-only screen of strict connector-topology carriageway support for T2 orphan links; no model fit, target accuracy claim, candidate change, or upload.

scope.official_geoid_reader: Four authoritative per-region sample GEOID columns only; preserve string IDs and sample order.

measure_before.reproduce: For each radius, derive positive-support GEOID sets from the frozen per-tract report in official sample order; verify regional and overall counts against the frozen aggregate summaries and report both order and support-set SHA-256 hashes.
measure_before.sha256_encoding: SHA-256 of newline-joined GEOID strings in authoritative sample order; no trailing newline.

topology_definition.road_source: provided Overture roads-unfiltered only; source row is zero-based ordinal across concatenated Parquet row groups; retain distinct source rows even if geometry duplicates.
topology_definition.link_rule: class/subclass contains link under the existing T2 exact predicate; use distinct connector IDs sorted by at-position and define first/last as link endpoint connectors.
topology_definition.orphan_link_rule: Both endpoint connectors must have at least one other incident road and no other incident named-class road, excluding the link row itself; matches registered T2-v2 semantics.
topology_definition.carriageway_candidate_rule: A candidate is a non-named, non-link road with exactly two distinct endpoint connector IDs and non-null geometry, incident at one orphan-link endpoint connector.
topology_definition.endpoint_pair: (orphan-link source row, candidate road source row, shared connector ID, candidate road's opposite endpoint connector ID).
topology_definition.unique_acceptance: Accept a pair only when exactly one qualifying orphan-link endpoint occurrence and exactly one eligible candidate road source row are incident to the shared connector, and that candidate road is incident to exactly one target orphan-link endpoint connector in the full region.
topology_definition.ambiguity_policy: Any endpoint with multiple eligible roads, repeated orphan-link endpoint incidence, or a candidate road touching multiple target orphan connectors is ambiguous; count and reject every such pair. No ambiguous pair may contribute coverage.
topology_definition.tract_support: Positive EPSG:5070 length of an accepted candidate-road source geometry inside an authoritative tract polygon, with no Euclidean buffer or radius.
topology_definition.unique_match_precision_proxy: accepted unique connector pairs divided by all eligible endpoint-to-road candidate pairs; this is only a topology-specificity proxy, not empirical precision against a reference.
topology_definition.coverage_metrics: Report orphan endpoint and orphan-link coverage; eligible/accepted/ambiguous connector pairs and road rows; unique source roads; official tracts with positive accepted attached-road length overall, by region, and by provided RUCA primary category/coverage flag.

forbidden: labels, target values, removed reference layers or equivalents
external data, external road networks, or outside packages/services
